title: MusicRWKV: A Multimodal RWKV Framework for Music Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.16718v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent music foundation models have achieved remarkable progress in music representation learning, yet most existing approaches rely on Transformer architectures whose quadratic attention complexity introduces substantial computational and memory overhead when modeling long-duration music recordings. In this work, we propose MusicRWKV, a multimodal music representation learning framework built upon the RWKV architecture. MusicRWKV jointly models waveform, spectrogram, and metadata information within a unified self-supervised learning framework. To improve efficiency for long musical sequences, we introduce an invertible compression module that reduces sequence length while preserving reconstruction capability. A FiLM-based conditioning strategy is employed to facilitate modality-aware representation learning without introducing expensive cross-attention operations. translated_title: MusicRWKV：一个用于音乐表征学习的多模态RWKV框架
translated_abstract: 近期音乐基础模型在音乐表征学习方面取得了显著进展，然而大多数现有方法依赖于Transformer架构，其二次方注意力复杂度在对长时间音乐录音进行建模时会带来巨大的计算与内存开销。在本工作中，我们提出了MusicRWKV，一个基于RWKV架构构建的多模态音乐表征学习框架。MusicRWKV在统一的自监督学习框架内联合建模波形、频谱图和元数据信息。为提高长音乐序列的处理效率，我们引入了一个可逆压缩模块，在保持重建能力的同时缩短序列长度。我们采用基于FiLM的条件化策略来促进模态感知的表征学习，而无需引入昂贵的交叉注意力操作。我们进一步研究了将Soft ROSA作为一种可微分（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了基于RWKV架构的多模态音乐表征学习框架MusicRWKV，以线性复杂度联合建模波形、频谱和元数据，并通过可逆压缩模块与FiLM条件化策略高效处理长音乐序列。
en_tdlr: MusicRWKV is a multimodal music representation learning framework built on the RWKV architecture that jointly models waveform, spectrogram, and metadata with linear complexity, leveraging invertible compression and FiLM conditioning for efficient long-sequence music modeling.
